01 / THE BIG IDEA

Your imagination.
The next playable thing.

Build Day is a game-making hackathon: a creative challenge to dream up, build, and share a project using Roblox Studio. Experiment, solve a few puzzles, and see your idea come to life.

It’s for Roblox players who are curious about creating. Bring an idea—or find one along the way. The goal: work toward a small, playable prototype you can be proud of.

02 / YOUR BUILD JOURNEY

Small steps. Big “I made that.”

PROPOSED 5-DAY SCHEDULE

From your first idea to a playable prototype. This is an example week; activities, dates, session lengths, and times are still to be confirmed.

  1. DAY 01↗
    01

    Dream it up

    Explore Roblox Studio and sketch the game you wish existed.

    CHECKPOINTA game idea & a plan
  2. DAY 02↗
    02

    Build your world

    Shape a map, place your objects, and give your game a setting.

    CHECKPOINTYour first environment
  3. DAY 03↗
    03

    Make it play

    Try scripting interactions, obstacles, and simple game rules.

    CHECKPOINTA playable game loop
  4. DAY 04↗
    04

    Test. Tweak. Repeat.

    Playtest with others, spot what breaks, and improve your build.

    CHECKPOINTA stronger prototype
  5. DAY 05✳
    05

    Show your stuff

    Add the finishing touches and share your game and what you learned.

    CHECKPOINTYour project, ready to share

03 / MADE BY YOU

One idea. So many possibilities.

Start small. Add your own twist.
These are example project ideas.

↗THE CHALLENGE MAKER

An obby with a twist

Wild jumps, sneaky obstacles, and a finish line worth chasing. Make a course your friends will want to try again.

Level designTesting & iteration
⌘THE WORLD BUILDER

A place to get lost in

A floating island? A secret hideout? Design a small world full of places to explore and details to discover.

3D buildingCreative planning
</>THE RULE BREAKER

Your own mini-game

Invent a simple challenge, give it a goal, and make it respond to the player. Your idea makes the rules.

Intro scriptingProblem solving
✳

More than a game. Practice turning ideas into plans, debugging when things break, giving feedback, and explaining how your creation works.

04 / A NOTE FOR PARENTS

Play is the spark.
Creating is the skill.

Build Day channels an interest in games into a hands-on creative project. The proposed activities make room for planning, logical thinking, experimentation, and learning from feedback.
